book.title: Nhalo ghwa Maha handa paghutyekitwe na Yohane Yohane

content: Yesu kanguapegha hilyo bhandu elufu nhano
Mbole ya agha, Yesu kakighenda kumwambo ya lihibha Galilaya, lyene bhubho bhandu bhngulikema lihibha Tibelia.
Na lumati lukulu lwa bhandu lukighendelela kuntughila, kiyaha bhakibhona mihabho mitangalo yakatendite kwa kualamiha atamwa.
Mbole Yesu kakikwela ku kitumbi na kakitama papamu na ahundwa bhake.
Na kikubhukubhu kya Akaayahudi kiikemwa Pasaka kikiheghelela kuhika.
Yesu pakakalolikihite kakilubhona lumati lukulu lwa bhandu paluntughila, kakinkonya Filipi, “Twahemela kwoki mulyo ghwa kuakwila bhandu bhoha abha ili alyeghe?”
Yesu kakikonya habhu kwa kuntegha Filipi, kiyaha kakimanya kya kukitenda.
Filipi kakinnyanga, “Ngalabha hya kutenda mahengo kwa myehi mitangali, hyangakwilite ng'obhe kuhemela hilyo hya kukwila hata kwa kila mundu kamokole kulyegha kyamandina.”
Yumu ywa ahundwa bhake, ywakakemitwe Andelea, aywo kakibhegha nnongo ywake Simoni Petili, kakinng'ombela Yesu,
“Apa kabhegha nhongolo yumu kabhegha na mangate nhano na hihomba hichoko hibhili. Peni ahi hyakwila niki kwa lumati alu lwoha?”
Yesu kakilongela, “Muaghombele bhandu atame pahi,” Na penipala pakibhegha na manyahi gha lukomba. Hino, bhandu bhoha bhakitama pahi, na pakibhegha na handa bhandu alume elufu nhano.
Ndo Yesu kakighatola ghala mangate, kakinnumba Chapanga, na kakiaghabhila bhandu bhaatamite. Kakitenda ubhwabhu kwa bhala homba, na kila mundu kakimokola na kulyegha handa bhula pakapalite kulyegha.
Bhandu bhoha paayomolite kulyegha na kuyukuta, Yesu kakiaghombela ahundwa bhake, “Nkugane mahighalo ghoha gha hipalamande, kikotoke kuhobha hata kipalamande kimu.”
Hino, bhakikungana hipalamande hyoha na kumemekeha hikapu mbinda mabhoko yimo na ibhili.
Bhandu paabhonite nhabho ghula ghwakaghutendite Yesu, bhakiyanda kulongela, “Kulyaghila mundu ayu ndo yula mbuye ywakahika munnima!”
Yesu kakimanya kukita bhandu bhangupala kuntenda kabheghe mutwa ywabhe kya lingakamiha, ndo kakibhuka na kughenda kangi ku kitumbi ghweka chake.
Yesu kangutyanga unani mwa machi
Payihikite makimuhi, ahundwa bha Yesu bhakihelela kukitumbi na kughenda mbaka ku lihibha.
Mbole bhakihubhuka mu bhwato, na bhakiyanda kuyomboka lihibha kughenda ku Kapelinaumu. Peniapo lubhindo lukiyingila kala, na Yesu kakibhegha kakali kuheghelela papamu na bhombe.
Lihibha likibyaluka kiyaha kukibhegha na likusi lingubyaluha machi.
Bhala ahundwa bhakihola bhwato kya utali ghwa kilomita nhano ebu sita, bhakinmona Yesu pakatyanga unani mwa machi, kanguheghelela ku bhwato, ndo bhakiyoghopa munu.
Peni Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nkotoke kuyoghopa, ndo Nenga!”
Ndo ahundwa bhakipala kuntekula Yesu mubhwato, kamu bhwato ghukihika paluhingo kula kwaabheghite bhangughenda.
Bhandu bhangunpalaha Yesu

Kilabho yake lula lumati lwa bhandu bhala bhaabheghite kula kumwambo ya lihibha bhaking'amula kukita, kukibhegha na bhwato ghumu ghweka. Na bhakimanya kukita Yesu kakiyingila ng'obhe mula mubhwato ghwaabhukite nabho papamu na ahundwa bhake, ngati ahundwa bhake bhakighenda ghweka chabhe.
Peni yikihika mibhwato yingi kuhuma ku Tibelia, ugheghela na pala paalyeghite mangate mbole ya Bambo Yesu kunnumba Chapanga.
Hino, lula lumati lwa bhandu lukimanya kukita Yesu kakibhegha ng'obhe pala, ebu ahundwa bhake nabho, ndo bhakihubhuka mu yila mibhwato, na bhakighenda akwo Kapelinaumu ngati bhakanpalahe Yesu.
Yesu lingate lya ubhumi
Bhala bhandu paammonite Yesu kumwambo ya lihibha bhakinkonya, “Nhunda, ghuhika pakiki apa?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Kulyaghila nenga nunguaghombela, mwenga mungumbalaha ng'obhe nenga kiyaha mukibhona mihabho yila, ngati mungumbalaha kiyaha mukilyegha yila mangate na mukiyukuta.

Nkotoke kutenda mahengo kwakya kumokola hilyo hinakupyokoka, ngati mmeghe mungutenda mahengo kwakya kumokola hilyo hiihighala mbaka muubhumi ghwangapela ghwa manjubha ghoha. Hilyo ahyo hyabhapegha ubhumi ghwa manjubha ghoha kuhuma kwa Chapanga. Mwana ywa Mundu ndo ywakapala kuapegha hilyo ahyo, kiyaha Tate Chapanga kampegha likalama lya kutenda habhu.”
Hino bhakinkonya Yesu, “Tutende niki twenga ngati tumokole kughatenda mahengo gha Chapanga?”
Yesu kakiayanga bhala bhandu, “Nnando ghwene Chapanga kangupala mughutende, munyubhalile nenga yunaghilitwe na ywombe.”
Habhu bhandu bhakinkonya, “Ghwatenda naho yoki ya nhabho ili tuyibhone na tughuhyubhalile? Ghwatenda nnando ghani?
Atate bhetu bhakilyegha hilyo hiikemwa mana kula kukibhala, handa muyityekitwe mu Malembo, ‘Kakiapegha mangate kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga ngati alyeghe.’ ”

Yesu kakiaghombela, “Kulyaghila nenga nunguaghombela, Musa kakiapegha ng'obhe hilyo hya mangate kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga, ngati Tate ywangu ndo ywakaapegha mwenga hilyo hya lingate lya hoto liihuma kunani.
Kiyaha hilyo hya Chapanga ndo yula yunakuhuluka pahi kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga ili kaapeghe bhandu bha nnima aghu ubhumi.”
Hino bhakinng'ombela Yesu, “Bambo, kutandila hinu ghutupeghe lingate alyo manjubha ghoha.”
Hino, Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nenga ndo lingate liabhapegha ubhumi, ywombe ywakahika kwa nenga na kunyubhalila katabhona ng'obhe njala hangi nyota.
Hino, handa panuaghombilite kukita payibhele mumona peni mungunyubhalila ng'obhe.
Bhala bhandu bhoha bhakambegha Tate bhahika kwa nenga. Na mundu ywohele ywakahika kwa nenga ndantanga ng'obhe panje,
Kiyaha nenga huluka kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga ili ngotoke kutenda ghambalite nenga, ngati ndende ghala ghakapalite Tate ywakanaghilite.
Tate ywakanaghilite kangupala habhu, ngotoke kunhobheha hata mundu yumu ywa bhala ghwakambeghite, ngati niahyuhe bhoha mulila linjubha lya uhiko.
Kiyaha kyakakipala Tate ghwangu ndo aki kukita kila ywakammona Mwana na kunyubhalila kabheghe na ubhumi ghwangapela ghwa manjubha ghoha. Na nenga ndabhahyuha linjubha lya uhiko.”
Hino, Akaayahudi bhakiyanda kunkuhyongolekela Yesu kiyaha kakilongela, “Nenga ndo lingate kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga.”
Bhakilongela, “Mundu ayu chepa Yesu mwana ywa Yosefu? Tunguamanya tate na mama ywake. Yibha bhuli, hinu kanguyigha kulongela kukita kahuluka kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga?”
Habhu Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nneke kuhyongoloka mabhene.
Kahone mundu ywakahotola kuhika kwa nenga handa kannongoha ng'obhe na Tate ywakanaghilite, na nenga ndanhyuha linjubha lya uhiko.
Mukitabho kya Chapanga mbuye yumu kakityeka, ‘Bhandu bhoha bhatahundwa na Chapanga.’ Na mundu ywohele ywakannyihwa Tate na kulihunda kuhuma kwa ywombe, aywo katahika kwa nenga.
Kahone mundu ywohele ywakammonite Tate, ngati ywombe ywakahumite kwa Chapanga, ywombe ndo ghweka chake ywakammonite Tate.
Kulyaghila nenga nungunng'ombela, mundu ywakanyubhalila kabhegha naghwo ubhumi ghwangapela ghwa manjubha ghoha.
Nenga ndo lingate lya ubhumi.
Atate bhenu bhakilyegha mana kula kukibhala, peni bhoha bhakihwegha.
Peni apa kubhegha lingate liihulukite pannima kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga ngati mundu ywohele ywakapala kulyegha kakotoke kuhwegha.

Nenga ndo lingate lya ubhumi, ghulala hihulukite kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga. Mundu ywohele pakalyegha lingate alyo, katalama manjubha ghoha. Lingate ali ndo mmili ghwangu, ghwene ghumbala kubhapegha kwakya ubhumi ghwa unnima.”
Ndo Akaayahudi bhakiyanda kughombana bhene paalongela. “Ayu katahotola bhuli kutupegha mmili ghwake tuulyeghe?”
Habhu Yesu kakiaghombela Akaayahudi, “Kulyaghila nenga nungunng'ombela, pankotoka kulyegha mmili ghwa Mwana ywa Mundu na kuunywegha mwahi ghwake, maabhegha ng'obhe na ubhumi ghwangapela nkati yenu.
Mundu ywohele ywakalyegha mmili ghwangu na kuuywegha mwahi ghwangu katabhegha na ubhumi ghwa manjubha ghoha, na nenga ndanhyuha linjubha lya uhiko.
Kiyaha mmili ghwangu ndo mulyo ghwa hoto na mwahi ghwangu ndo kiywegho kya hoto.
Mundu ywohele yunakulyegha mmili ghwangu na kunywegha mwahi ghwangu katatama nkati yangu, na nenga ndatama nkati yake.
Handa bhula Tate ywakanaghilite mwakabheghite na ubhumi. Na nenga ningulama kupitila kwa Tate, habhu ywakalyegha mmili ghwa nenga katalama kupitila nenga.
Ali ndo lingate liihuluka kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga, libhegha ng'obhe handa mana yaalyeghite akaatate bhenu, mbole bhakihwegha, peni ywohele yunakulyegha lingate ali katalama manjubha ghoha.”
Yesu kakilongela malagho agha pakabheghite kanguhunda mu Nyumba ya kukonganikila Akaayahudi akwo Kapelinaumu.
Malagho ghanakuyegha ubhumi ghwangapela ghwa manjubha ghoha
Atangalo mu ahundwa bhake paayihwite nnando aghu bhakilongela, “Mahundo agha gghangumanyika ng'obhe yeghuyeghu. Ndo ghani ywakahotola kughakingama?”
Yesu kaking'amula mwene kyanga kughombelwa na mundu kukita ahundwa bhake bhakinhyongoleka yakya mahundo ghake, ndo kakiakonya, “Bhuli, nnando aghu ghunguayaghabhiha?
Yabhegha bhuli hinu pala pamummona Mwana ywa Mundu pakabhyela kughenda akwo kwakabheghite kandahi?
Nhuki ywa Chapanga ndo yunakuapegha bhandu ubhumi, mmili ndo kilibhi ng'obhe. Malagho agha ghaniaghombilite ndo ghanguhuma kwa Nhuki ywa Chapanga na kuapegha ubhumi.
Peni amoo bhenu munguhyubhalila ng'obhe.” Kiyaha Yesu kakimanya ghoha kutandila kalongohi ndo aghani bhangunhyubhalila mu nkati yabhe na aghani bhangupala kunkiluka.
Mbole Kakilongela kangi, “Ndo mana nikiaghombela kukita kahone mundu ywohele ywakapala kuhotola kunhikila kyangalongohwa na Tate ywangu.”
Kubhukana na nnando ghula kutandila pala, amoo ahundwa bhake bhakibhuya kihyengelenyuma bhakileka kulongohana na Yesu.
Habhu Yesu kakiakonya bhala andumila bhake mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili, “Bhuli, na mwenga mungupala kubhuka?”
Simoni Petili kakinnyanga, “Bambo, tubhuke tughende kwoki? Ghwenga ghubhegha na malagho gha ubhumi ghwa manjubha ghoha.
Tunguhyubhalila na kumanya kukita ghwenga ndo Ywakahaghulitwe kuhuma kwa Chapanga yunaubhumi.”
Ndo Yesu kakiayanga, “Nikiahaghula mwenga mbinda mabhoko yimu na abhili. Peni yumu ywenu kangulongohwa na Nchipila!”
Apa Yesu kakilongela agho yakya Yuda, mwana ghwa Simoni Isikaliote, mana aywo ndo ywakapala kunkiluka. Payibhele kakibhegha mu bhala ahundwa mbindamabhoko yimo na abhili.
